text:
morgan: Customer (AcmeApps) flagged an invoice where billed tokens are ~3x what their SDK estimator reported. They attached the request id and a short curl. Can we triage?

jess: Can you paste the exact payload and whether they used streaming or the regular completion API? Also need request_id header.

morgan: They said streaming=false. Here's the curl they used (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-2025","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize sales notes"}],"temperature":0.0}'
```
Request-ID: rwd-2026-11-03-9a7cfd

sabrina: thanks. Quick note — we've seen a pattern where server-side post-completion metadata (assistant messages that contain KV cache or tool-output trailers) are included in our meter but are not visible to lightweight SDK estimators. Does the customer see any additional function/tool output?

morgan: They call an internal summarizer tool once per response; customer said tool output is small. They also attached the server-side meter snapshot from the invoice: server_count=542, sdk_estimate=180. Request-ID above.

metering-bot: Automated diagnostic for rwd-2026-11-03-9a7cfd: 
server_token_count=542
client_reported_estimate=180
server_injected_trailer_messages=312
likely_causes=["tool-output-kv-trailer","invisible-assistant-postmessage","opaque-metadata-header"]

jess: OK that automated breakdown is useful. Repro instructions for customer: 1) re-run the same payload with debug headers: `X-Redwood-Debug: true` and `X-Redwood-Return-Raw: true` 2) capture response headers and the raw response body (we want to see any assistant messages emitted after main completion) 3) enable SDK verbose tokenizer logs if possible (sdk.DEBUG=true) 4) paste `Request-ID` here.

morgan: I'll ask them to run and send raw response. They said spikes happen when they batch 6 concurrent requests. Could concurrency affect server-side trailer insertion?

sabrina: It can. Hypothesis: runtime dedup/kv cache inserts a post-response assistant payload (opaque) to prime clients or for cache warmup. SDK estimator currently counts only request+main-assistant messages; it skips server-injected trailers emitted after the completion boundary. That would undercount client estimates vs invoice.

jess: Created INC-6231 to track. Action items: (a) get raw response+headers from customer (b) add missing header capture to meter pipeline to surface postcompletion tokens in debug UI (c) short-term: add note in support KB that server trailers may be billed even if SDK estimator doesn't see them.

morgan: Thanks — I'll ping once customer shares the debug output. :thumbsup:

sabrina: If customer shares sample, we can run a local replay with `X-Redwood-Replay-Trace: rwd-2026-11-03-9a7cfd` and dump tokenization boundaries to confirm where those 312 tokens are coming from.

morgan: Got it, will escalate this to them and capture logs.
